name: Desktop Conversion Rail
summary: Extends the proven mobile availability prompt to desktop with a responsive, dismissible conversion rail and permanent regression coverage.
changes: Public beta badge is rendered from platform-manifest.json as the single source of truth
Production mode suppresses the badge without removing website code
Release identity rendering avoids unsafe manifest interpolation
Release identity governance is now part of the mandatory full quality suite

Check desktop and mobile placement and confirm the badge does not block navigation or enquiry actions
Temporarily set release_identity.public_badge to false and confirm the badge disappears
Run npm run quality before deployment
title: Desktop Conversion Rail
highlights: Adds a desktop availability contact rail while preserving the successful Android mobile pattern
Uses one responsive component across mobile and desktop
Allows desktop visitors to dismiss the rail for the current session
Keeps the AI launcher clear of the conversion rail at all supported breakpoints
Adds regression coverage for markup, behaviour, accessibility and responsive layout
